description: This source file defines a configuration data structure and a set of utility functions for storing, retrieving, and managing relay configuration settings and events in user defaults. It appears to be part of an app's shared settings or gateway relay management.

classes.name: ShareGatewayRelayConfig
classes.description: A data structure encapsulating relay configuration details, conforming to Codable, Sendable, and Equatable for serialization and thread safety.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and decodes the relay configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Encodes and saves the relay configuration into user defaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Saves a timestamped message indicating the last event in user defaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from user defaults, if any.
